---
title: "Import and analyse ASV portal data with R"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

This tutorial walks through the main steps for importing and analysing ASV portal data in R. The first two steps are the same for everyone. Then you choose **one** of two alternative tracks, which follow the same steps with different data:

- **Track A, insects:** COI metabarcoding data from the [Insect Biome Atlas](https://www.insectbiomeatlas.org/){target="_blank"} (IBA) project, which sampled arthropods with Malaise traps at 200 sites across six habitat types in Sweden. We combine two datasets generated with different extraction protocols, homogenate and lysate.
- **Track B, marine plankton:** 16S metabarcoding data of bacterioplankton from the Baltic Sea, from a transect sampled in 2013 and monitoring stations sampled in 2019–2020, along the salinity gradient from the Bothnian Bay to the Skagerrak.

### Common steps

1. [Environment setup](tutorial-01-setup.qmd) — Access the workshop RStudio environment (or run locally), and choose your data
2. [Data preparation](tutorial-02-prep.qmd) — Load, merge and aggregate data from the ASV portal

### Track A: Insects

*An alternative to track B.*

3. [Sample mapping](insects-03-map.qmd) — Filter, pair and map samples across Sweden and habitat types
4. [Community differences (beta diversity)](insects-04-beta.qmd) — Bray-Curtis dissimilarity and PCoA
5. [Within-sample diversity (alpha diversity)](insects-05-alpha.qmd) — Shannon diversity across habitat types
6. [Taxonomic composition](insects-06-composition.qmd) — Barplots across habitats and months

### Track B: Marine plankton

*An alternative to track A.*

3. [Sample mapping](plankton-03-map.qmd) — Map samples and their salinity across the Baltic Sea
4. [Community differences (beta diversity)](plankton-04-beta.qmd) — Bray-Curtis dissimilarity and PCoA
5. [Within-sample diversity (alpha diversity)](plankton-05-alpha.qmd) — Shannon diversity along the salinity gradient
6. [Taxonomic composition](plankton-06-composition.qmd) — Barplots across salinity and months

[Get started →](tutorial-01-setup.qmd)
